sentence: This project studies when a drug that boosts antigen presentation in cancer cells works best together with immunotherapy.
This project develops a therapy using immune cells to remove scar-forming cells in the heart affected by cardiac fibrosis.
This project builds treatment systems that use hydrogel beads holding bacteria cultures to clean contaminated sediment and soil.
This project tries to find out which molecular subtypes of Alzheimer's disease are linked to cognitive function, using omics data and machine learning.
This project builds an open-source toolkit that reads clinical narratives to collect treatment and outcome data for breast cancer patients.
This project develops genetically modified pigs that can host a nonhuman primate heart.
This project builds enzymes and chemical probes that tag proteins and lipids in living animals.
This project uses a worm as a model to study how small regulatory RNAs are made and how they work throughout an animal.
This project studies how differences in mitochondrial DNA change gut microbes and immune responses against tumors such as melanoma.
This project studies what leads to loneliness and alcohol problems in Hispanic individuals who drink, looking at social and cultural factors.
This project studies how two modifications of a protein in cardiomyocytes affect heart failure caused by hypertension.
This project studies how oscillations in the entorhinal cortex affect communication with the hippocampus during memory consolidation.
This project studies how the physical properties of the nucleus change in senescent cells and how those changes cause dysfunction in transcription and splicing.
This project uses artificial intelligence on electronic health records to predict recurrence and long-term complications of diverticulitis.
This project builds nucleic acids nanoparticles that deliver genetic materials into hematopoietic stem cells to guide genome editing.
This project studies and improves a way to measure neural function in the living human retina, then tests it in patients with inherited retinal degenerations.
This project develops fluorescently labeled antibodies that target a protein found in colon cancer to highlight the tumor and its edges.
This project studies how the molecular machines dynein and kinesin move cargos inside cells and how cells repair DNA damage.
This project studies how platelet and neutrophil activity relate to cerebrovascular disease and Alzheimer's disease in two human cohorts.
This project studies how hearing damage changes brain connections between the auditory cortex and the amygdala.
